hunt.justification: Edge AI environments are outside the direct control of providers and store sensitive model IP and data. Verifying the integrity of artifacts at rest and the legitimacy of runtime behavior is a critical customer obligation.

scenario.summary: Attackers target edge AI environments by compromising the supply chain with malicious firmware or model updates, then use prompt injection or tampered artifacts to steer model behavior. Once control is established, sensitive assets including model weights and customer data are exfiltrated over proxied command-and-control channels.

meta.rationale: Focus on hosts running PyTorch, Ollama, or TensorFlow as identified via software inventory. Exclude development machines if possible to reduce noise from legitimate experimentation.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary has compromised the Edge AI supply chain or tampered with local model artifacts, using multi-hop proxies to exfiltrate sensitive model weights or credentials.

hunt.name: Edge AI Artifact Integrity and Supply Chain
hunt.description: As organizations move AI model execution to the edge, the trust boundary shifts to customer-owned infrastructure. This hunt identifies systems running AI runtimes and monitors for two critical threats: the modification of sensitive AI artifacts (weights, configurations, and agent definitions) by unauthorized processes, and the exfiltration of these assets. We use high-volume network egress and proxy-related DNS activity to corroborate potential data theft and command-and-control masking via Tor or ORB networks.

config.content: SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname, package_name, package_version FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE instr(',' || '{{ai_runtime_packages}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(package_name) || ',') > 0
config.description: Find systems running AI libraries or engines to establish the behavioral scope.
config.expected_signal: A list of hosts likely acting as inference nodes. Silence means no recognized AI stack is present via managed inventory.

primitive_config.label: Identify hosts with AI runtimes
primitive_config.content: SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname, package_name, package_version FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE instr(',' || '{{ai_runtime_packages}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(package_name) || ',') > 0
primitive_config.expected: A list of hosts likely acting as inference nodes. Silence means no recognized AI stack is present via managed inventory.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, file_name, file_path, activity_name, time FROM hb_file_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND activity_id IN (1, 3, 5) AND (LOWER(file_name) LIKE '%.safetensors' OR LOWER(file_name) LIKE '%.pt' OR LOWER(file_name) LIKE '%.pth' OR LOWER(file_name) LIKE '%.onnx' OR LOWER(file_name) LIKE '%.weights' OR LOWER(file_name) LIKE '%.bin' OR LOWER(file_name) LIKE '%.gguf') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Detect modifications to model weights or configurations by identifying writes to sensitive AI file extensions.
config.expected_signal: Unauthorized processes modifying model files. Writes from rare processes or shells are suspicious.

primitive_config.label: Model artifact tampering
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, file_name, file_path, activity_name, time FROM hb_file_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND activity_id IN (1, 3, 5) AND (LOWER(file_name) LIKE '%.safetensors' OR LOWER(file_name) LIKE '%.pt' OR LOWER(file_name) LIKE '%.pth' OR LOWER(file_name) LIKE '%.onnx' OR LOWER(file_name) LIKE '%.weights' OR LOWER(file_name) LIKE '%.bin' OR LOWER(file_name) LIKE '%.gguf') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: Unauthorized processes modifying model files. Writes from rare processes or shells are suspicious.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, dst_endpoint_ip, SUM(traffic_bytes) as total_bytes, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_network_connection WHERE state_kind = 'log' AND direction = 'outbound' AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, process_name, dst_endpoint_ip HAVING total_bytes > 52428800 ORDER BY total_bytes DESC
config.description: Identify high-volume or rare outbound data transfers indicative of weight or credential theft.
config.expected_signal: Outbound transfers exceeding 50MB to rare destination IPs from Edge AI nodes.

primitive_config.label: Bulk network egress prevalence
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, dst_endpoint_ip, SUM(traffic_bytes) as total_bytes, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_network_connection WHERE state_kind = 'log' AND direction = 'outbound' AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, process_name, dst_endpoint_ip HAVING total_bytes > 52428800 ORDER BY total_bytes DESC
primitive_config.expected: Outbound transfers exceeding 50MB to rare destination IPs from Edge AI nodes.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, query_hostname, process_name, COUNT(*) as query_count FROM hb_dns_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND (LOWER(query_hostname) LIKE '%.onion%' OR LOWER(query_hostname) LIKE '%exitnode%' OR LOWER(query_hostname) LIKE '%.tor%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, query_hostname, process_name
config.description: Identify C2 masking via Tor or onion services on AI-enabled hosts.
config.expected_signal: DNS resolution of onion domains or proxy services, which are atypical for inference workloads.

config.objective: Determine if unauthorized processes modified AI model artifacts and whether that coincided with high-volume outbound traffic or proxy DNS activity. Distinguish between standard software updates and potential supply chain/local tampering.
config.description: Review combined signals to determine if Edge AI environments have been tampered with or used for exfiltration.
config.expected_signal: A per-host verdict linking process behavior to file tampering and network egress.
config.success_criteria: A per-host verdict of Malicious | Suspicious | Benign with row citations.

config.question: the triage verdict is malicious for at least one host involving suspicious artifact modification and concurrent data egress
config.condition: the triage verdict is malicious for at least one host involving suspicious artifact modification and concurrent data egress
config.description: Escalate to IR or analyst review based on the triage agent's confidence.
Contain potential data theft and stop further tampering.
config.instructions: Isolate the host from the network and revoke credentials used by the AI runtime service account. Collect model weights for hash verification.

config.description: Verify the findings and perform provenance checks on the identified artifacts.
config.instructions: Review the processes that modified model files. Check for evidence of 'poisoned' retrieval documents or unauthorized weight updates. Determine if the egress IP belongs to a legitimate vendor or a multi-hop proxy.

config.description: Finalize the hunt and document the verified state of AI assets.
config.instructions: Record the hosts with AI software and the integrity status of their model artifacts. Update the 'known-good' baseline for future hunts.
